catalogue.name: The Convents of the Faithful
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Unwavering conviction
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Superior Informants: use when an enemy unit enters the board using insertion or Ambush. It receives one (1) action marker. Alternatively, use when an enemy unit as it enters the board using Infiltrate or Vanguard. It receives two (2) action markers.
● Higher Intervention: 1 friendly regular model gets Mystic(Miracles 2) until end of turn. You may spend an extra FP to give it Mystic(3) instead.
● Holy Trinity: until end of turn all your attacks with Hand flamers, Flamers, and Heavy flamers get range +3”, Heatguns and Heat cannons get range +3” and platebreaker(+1.5”), HMGs get attack(+1).

sharedRules.name: Bestow Loathing (12”, faithful)
sharedRules.description: All faithful models in units within 12" gains Loathing: Re-roll results of ‘1’ to wound for this model.

sharedRules.name: Faith and Deeds
sharedRules.description: Spend one (1) FP: Remove all remaining action markers from one (1) faithful unit in endphase.

sharedRules.name: Shield of Faith
sharedRules.description: Spend one (1) FP: The Opponent has to reroll all hits from one attack made against a faithful unit.

sharedRules.name: Divine Inspiration
sharedRules.description: Spend one (1) FP: One (1) unit gains Move(+1) until the endphase.

sharedRules.name: Propaganda Loudspeaker
sharedRules.description: Bestow Tough(+1) (12”, does not stack with itself).

sharedRules.name: Bestow Defence(min 4) (12”, faithful)
sharedRules.description: All faithful models in units within 12" gains Defence(min 4). If a unit already has trait at a better level, it takes precedence.

sharedRules.name: Martyr(restore all wounds, one use)
sharedRules.description: When this model is removed as a casualty, restore all wounds.

sharedRules.name: Icon-carrier
sharedRules.description: If this model is the target of the higher intervention faction power, roll 1 extra dice and increase the power’s range by 6”.

sharedRules.name: Banner-carrier
sharedRules.description: Friendly models without CC-weapons within 12” get CC (1).

sharedRules.name: Liaison
sharedRules.description: You may purchase a single non-command entry from the Republic force list. This does not count as a core or special choice.

sharedRules.name: Sword of Uriel
sharedRules.description: Relic Blade, combined Flamer with Charge(shoot).

sharedRules.name: Cherub bomb
sharedRules.description: Unit has 1-2x Bomb-creature and can use them as a free action/ reaction.
